name: docs-editor-links
title: Add VitePress edit links and a read-only documentation editor
description: Implement Phase 2 of the approved documentation workflow: environment-gated VitePress edit links and an authenticated, read-only editor platform with safe document loading and preview status.
scope: docs/.vitepress, editor, scripts/docs-editor-*, deploy/editor, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, .trellis/spec/documentation-preview-workflow.md
creator: wg
notes: Phase 2 is deployed to kbdev. The editor remains read-only and has no save, Git, SSH, Kooboo, or filesystem write API. Public VitePress builds keep edit links disabled unless DOCS_EDITOR_BASE_URL is explicitly set. The first verified Phase 2 preview release was 20260811T063649Z-abc9cf0-10; subsequent documentation-only commits continue through the same atomic Git sync pipeline. Kooboo.Web remains active.
